main_policy: Never merge or push main without an explicit new user request.

authority.legacy_sources: planning/*.yaml and imported original YAML remain traceable inputs; do not overwrite live task state with a new import.

architecture.employee_management: Within department/ressort; avatars remain production identities and workflow roles.
architecture.languages: Editorial defines active output languages and default; shows and individual items inherit or select approved variants.

features_to_preserve: Editorial departments, virtual staff, source checking, editing, revision and human approval
Shows composed of reusable plugins: news blocks, studio conversations, uploaded video, topical short video, intro/outro
Standalone contributions in virtual employee name from existing clusters or manual text/media inputs
Recurring shows, avatar/studio wizards, optional GPU/local and opt-in external providers
Independent production and publication queues with versioned config snapshots
Mandatory final-video YYYY/MM/DD archive and always-visible bottom-right AI label
Cost preview, budget control, social export and opt-in publishing

release_policy.code_publish: Push tested version milestones; explicitly requested independent changes may be pushed separately. Never call an unfinished version complete.
release_policy.documentation: Consolidate docs, render diagrams and sync wiki only after confirmed completed/tested subversion, matching marker and version tag.
procedure: Finish/review every task assigned to the current version; preserve evidence and run integration checks.
Commit/push the tested version only to Full-featured-Newsoutlet. A task completion is not automatically a version release.
Confirm matching documentation-release marker and VERSION; create version tag to consolidate diagrams/docs/wiki.
When moving to next version, change active_version in the board and project metadata deliberately and reset release confirmation flags.

coordination.identity_model: Trusted Git writers self-declare client IDs; this is coordination, not cryptographic user authentication.
coordination.uncommitted_local_0_1_work: Marked local_work_pending; reconcile deliberately after integration before another client claims it.

task_state_import.imported_status: 4 previously completed; 10 unfinished local 0.1 tasks require reconciliation; remaining tasks planned.

github_mirror.issues: One issue per task, identified by immutable task ID marker; preserve human text outside managed body block.
github_mirror.versions: One milestone per version; do not infer version completion from closed issues alone.
github_mirror.packages: One package:Axx label per package, with managed status labels.
github_mirror.claims: Client claims, leases, file scopes and reviews remain in task-board.json, not issue assignment.
github_mirror.project_board: No GitHub Project required initially; issues plus milestones provide the initial view.
github_mirror.publication: Ordinary task mirror updates do not generate diagrams or publish wiki; main is never changed.

updates.scope: all fork branches compared with corresponding original branches
updates.comparison: ahead/behind commit graph; includes divergent and missing counterparts
updates.notification: new or changed behind status per branch; compare link and sync action
updates.synchronization: per branch or selected branches; configurable automatic conflict-free synchronization
updates.conflicts: retain branch, report conflict or prepare reviewable PR
updates.local_checkout: separate from remote fork synchronization; preserve uncommitted files and user data
